text:
samira: FYI - bringing up a dynamic 4-bit quant path for small-redwood-v2 on the perf eval harness. cost_per_token looks promising but p95 latency jumped ~20%

oliver: can you paste the run command and the metric names you used?

samira: sure:
```
./run_eval --model small-redwood-v2 --quant dynamic-4bit --batch 8 --duration 10m --metrics cost_per_token,latency_p50,latency_p95
```

maria: quick sanity check - our dashboard expects latency_p95_ms and cost_per_token_usd tags, not the plain names. did the runner mapper change?

samira: hmm I used the default runner build from main, didn't touch mapper. output in logs shows latency_p95 and cost_per_token (no unit suffix).

aj: that explains the dashboard mismatch. CI's metric contract test asserts exact metric keys. eval-runner-bot should have caught that and failed the job, right?

ci-bot: pipeline/eval-perf #422 failed - metric-contract-check: missing metrics [latency_p95_ms, cost_per_token_usd] - see job 422 logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/422

eval-runner-bot: I emitted metrics: latency_p50, latency_p95, cost_per_token. Mapper version: v0.12.0.

maria: mapper v0.12.0 was rolled in last week for the new multi-model output. It intentionally removed _ms/_usd suffixes to be unit-agnostic, but dashboards + CI weren't updated.

oliver: oof. two issues then: (1) metric keys drifted, (2) p95 regression could be real. We need to decouple contract fix from perf investigation so we can triage properly.

samira: agree. for perf - I reran a short sweep and saw p50 ~same, p95 +18% on 1k sample window. CPU/GPU utilization looks normal, but KV cache hit rate dropped 5% after quant change.

aj: KV cache drop could explain tail latency. Did quantization change tokenization or request padding?

samira: no tokenization change. payload distribution identical. I suspect quant exec path has occasional micro-stalls (~2-4ms) during KV fetch because of new kernel alignment.

maria: for the immediate CI unblock, I'll add a compatibility shim in metrics-ingest that maps latency_p95 -> latency_p95_ms and cost_per_token -> cost_per_token_usd until dashboards are migrated. small PR incoming.

oliver: please also add a failing test that asserts the mapping so we don't regress again.

aj: I'll re-run the failed CI after the shim. samira, can you attach the raw trace for one of the p95 outliers? Kernel + timeline would help.

samira: attaching snippet below (trimmed):
```
TRACE: request_id=rc-12a3, start=0.000, kv_lookup=0.002, quant_exec_wait=0.006, token_emit=0.001, end=0.009
TRACE: request_id=rc-7f9, start=0.000, kv_lookup=0.002, quant_exec_wait=0.012, token_emit=0.001, end=0.015  <-- outlier
```

aj: quant_exec_wait spikes align with the p95s. can you repro with per-request profiling? enable RDTSC sampling and larger sample count.

samira: starting a 30m run with profiling and prefetch warm cache. will post results.

maria: PR 780 created: metrics-ingest: add backwards-compatible mapping for v0.12 metric keys -> v0.11 dashboard keys. includes test. link: https://git.redwood/infra/metrics-ingest/pulls/780

ci-bot: PR 780 pipeline passed: unit + integration checks green.

aj: re-triggering eval pipeline job 423 with shim in place.

ci-bot: pipeline/eval-perf #423 started.

eval-runner-bot: run 423 emitted metrics: latency_p95_ms=147.2, cost_per_token_usd=0.00037, kv_cache_hit=0.87

oliver: good — metric contract satisfied. samira, any early signal from the profiling run?

samira: initial profiling (2000 samples) shows quant_exec_wait median 5.8ms, 95th 12.1ms, but when KV cache hit <0.9 the 95th moves to ~16ms. seems correlated to partial cache misses.

maria: that suggests quantized kernel is more sensitive to KV cache locality. we might need to tweak prefetch policy or batch alignment.

aj: action items: (1) maria merge shim (done), (2) samira run longer prof and create a minimal repro to isolate kernel behavior, (3) oliver open infra ticket to add metric-key contract test in harness CI, (4) I'll add a dashboard note about unit suffix migration.

samira: starting a 2h run now with aggressive prefetch and bigger batch sizes to see impact. will post summary in this thread when done.

oliver: thanks everyone. let's not roll this quant path to dedicated or public until we have stable p95 and a mapping cleanup plan. :thumbsup: 

maria: filed infra ticket #1593 for harness contract test and dashboard migration checklist.

samira: update: at 40m, p95 improved ~6% with prefetch=on and batch=12. still doing the 2h run, will include flamegraphs.

aj: keeping this thread open for perf artifacts. if anything urgent, ping me directly.

eval-runner-bot: archived run artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/runs/423 (profiles, traces, metrics)

samira: summary planned for next week: reproduce steps, kernel regression hypothesis, perf delta table (cost_per_token vs p95) and suggested mitigations.

aj: perfect. thanks all.
